controls.negative: a vacuum character without the adjoint at q^2 fails the BPS comparison

notes: Cross-presentation: the BPS chart (Habiro/Nahm engine) versus the BPS-free Kac-Wakimoto character and bootstrap.

checks.name: Tr 1, Tr T_0, Tr D_0 through q^6 equal the printed expansions
Tr 1 of the BPS chart SU3BPSKAlgebra (the exact Habiro engine) equals the Kac-Wakimoto series through q^6
Tr(T_0^a) and Tr(D_0^a) are O(q^a) for a = 1, 2, 3 (the constraint the bootstrap deconvolves)
negative control: the BPS chart's Tr 1 has chi_(1,1) at q^2, so a vacuum character without the adjoint current would fail
